from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
p='client/android/app/src/androidTest/java/com/getcapacitor/myapp/ExampleInstrumentedTest.java'
source=Path(p).read_bytes()
application_id=re.search(r'applicationId "([^"]+)"',Path('client/android/app/build.gradle').read_text()).group(1)
assert application_id=='app.studentpanel.mobile'
assert f'assertEquals("{application_id}", appContext.getPackageName());'.encode() in source
original=source.replace(b'app.studentpanel.mobile',b'com.getcapacitor.app')
record=next(f for f in json.loads(Path('audit/inventory.json').read_text())['files'] if f['path']==p)
assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==record['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'applicationId':application_id,'matchesConfiguredId':True,'onlyOriginalAssertionChanged':True,'originalSha256':record['sha256'],'patchedSha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'verification':'source only; Android not executed'}))
